coverage_note: Read in full: §§ 132, 136 and 140. §§ 67, 138 and 145: only the paragraphs containing 'fulfil', 'fullness' or 'empty'. Not read: §§ 66, 68, 124, 131, 147 and 149 (5-11 term hits each) and the rest of Parts Three and Four.

units.claim: Self-givenness, as the limit-state of clarification, is distinguished from originary, bodily or perceptual givenness.
Fullness is the clarity-mode of givenness: a darkly and a clearly conscious object can share an identical sense while differing in fullness.
units.quote: So the sense (the determination-content) is identical across clarity-levels, while the fullness (the clarity) differs.

units.claim: The full core of the noema is defined as the sense in the mode of its fullness.
units.quote: As full core we will accordingly reckon precisely the full concretion of the relevant noematic stock-piece, hence the sense in the mode of its fullness.

units.claim: The difference between blind and insightful judgment does not concern the sense or proposition, which is identical in both, but whether it is filled or unfilled.
units.quote: The difference concerns the way how the mere sense, or proposition — which as mere abstractum in the concretion of the consciousness-noema demands a plus of completing moments — is filled or unfilled sense and proposition.

units.claim: Fullness alone does not decide; the how of fulfillment matters, the intuitive mode and within it the distinguished originarily-giving mode.
units.quote: Fullness of the sense alone does not make it out, it depends also on the how of the fulfillment. An experience-way of the sense is the "intuitive," whereby the "meant object as such" is intuitively conscious

units.claim: Evidence is defined as the unity of a reason-positing with the originary givenness that essentially motivates it, with a noetic and a noematic side.
units.quote: Insight, in general evidence (Evidenz) is thus a quite distinguished occurrence; according to its "core" it is the unity of a reason-positing with the it essence-wise motivating

units.claim: Talk of fulfillment has a double sense: the character the thesis takes on through the mode of the sense, and the peculiarity of that sense to harbor a fullness that rationally motivates.
units.quote: Once it is "fulfillment of the intention," as a character that the actual thesis takes on through the special mode of the sense; the other time it is precisely the peculiarity of this mode itself, or the peculiarity of the relevant sense, to harbor in itself a "fullness" that rationally motivates.

units.claim: In the inadequate sphere of realities, the experience-course fills the empty places of preceding appearances in unanimous fulfillment whose reason-power steadily increases, and positings gain weight.
units.quote: precisely the experience-course in which the empty-places of the preceding appearances fill themselves, the indeterminacies determine themselves more closely, and so constantly in the way of thoroughgoing unanimous fulfillment with its steadily self-increasing reason-power.

units.claim: An evident and a non-evident act of the same sense can come to coincidence, in which the evident positing confirms the non-evident one.
units.quote: There can, for example, an evident act and a non-evident one come to coincidence, whereby in the transition from the latter to the former this takes on the character of the verifying, that of the self-verifying.

units.claim: Not every imperfect evidence prescribes a fulfillment-course ending in an originary evidence of the same sense; for memory and empathy originary confirmation is excluded in principle.
units.quote: It is to be seen that not every imperfect evidence prescribes thereby a fulfillment-course that terminates in a corresponding originary evidence, in one of the same sense; on the contrary, through certain evidence-kinds such a so-to-speak originary confirmation is in principle excluded.

units.claim: For essence-positings the intuitive re-presentation of perfect fulfillment is equivalent to the fulfillment itself, unlike existence-positings of the Real, which need actual experience.
units.quote: in every case of an essence-positing, or essence-proposition, the intuitive re-presentation of its perfect fulfillment is equivalent with the fulfillment itself

units.claim: Evidence is a positing-mode belonging to the essence-constitution of the noema, and essence-laws govern consciousness of fulfillment of the intention and its counter-characters of disconfirming.
units.quote: that there is, for example, something like consciousness of the "fulfillment of the intention," of the specifically on the thetic characters related justification and confirmation, just as the corresponding counter-characters of the disrighting, disconfirming.
